resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a standard biometric update because every de-duplication candidate matched on face and every one of them was adjudicated a false positive, with the applicant not whitelisted.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update, which must authenticate against their own parent Aadhaar. The whole candidate set was face-matching records discounted as false positives, so the update was held up by matches that were never accepted as duplicates. The packet can be replayed once the false-positive candidates are settled, and the resident need do nothing.
